sentence_stem: Had the committee been informed earlier,
correct_completion: the report would have been revised before publication.
full_sentence: Had the committee been informed earlier, the report would have been revised before publication.
acceptable_variants: the report would have been amended in time.
the draft would have been corrected before it was released.

options.text: the report is revised every year.
options.why_wrong: This is a habitual present statement, which does not match the hypothetical past condition set by 'had ... been informed'.

options.text: the report will be revised tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: A future tense does not complete a third conditional structure, which needs 'would have' plus a past participle.

options.text: the report would have been revised before publication.
the report was revised by the committee last year.
options.why_wrong: This describes a completed past event, unrelated to the hypothetical result of an earlier notification.

grammar_focus: Third conditional with inverted 'had' in the if-clause
explanation: The stem uses an inverted third conditional without 'if', so the main clause must contain 'would have' followed by a past participle. Turkish speakers often add a conditional marker in the main clause, but English keeps the modal and perfect structure instead.
translation: Komite daha önce bilgilendirilseydi, rapor yayımlanmadan önce revize edilmiş olurdu.
